steps.en: Deploy the app to your Vercel account
steps.zh: 把应用部署到你的 Vercel 账号

steps.en: Create a GitHub App pointing at the deployment, set its keys as env vars, install it on repos
steps.zh: 建 GitHub App 指向部署地址，配好环境变量，装到仓库上

steps.en: Mention the bot in a PR comment, optionally with an instruction
steps.zh: 在 PR 评论里 @ 它，可以附一句要求
steps.code: @openreview run the linter and fix any issues

steps.en: Starts a durable workflow, clones the PR branch into a sandbox and installs dependencies
steps.zh: 起一个持久化工作流，把 PR 分支克隆进沙箱并装依赖

steps.en: Claude reads the diff, explores the code and runs project tooling inside the sandbox
steps.zh: Claude 读 diff、翻代码，在沙箱里跑项目自带的工具

steps.en: Posts inline comments with suggestion blocks; commits and pushes any fixes it made
steps.zh: 贴出带 suggestion 块的行内评论，有改动就提交推回分支

value.en: A reviewer that has actually run your linter and tests answers on the PR, and small fixes arrive as commits
value.zh: 真跑过你的 lint 和测试的审查意见回到 PR 上，小修复直接以提交的形式送到
